relation: fun b n => n = if b then 1 else 0
definitions: Definition forward (b : Source) : Target := if b then 1 else 0.
Definition backward (n : Target) : Source := match n with | 0 => false | _ => true end.

laws.name: forward_related
laws.statement: forall b : Source, transfer_rel b (forward b)
laws.proof: intro b. unfold transfer_rel, forward. reflexivity.

laws.name: section_law
laws.statement: forall b : Source, backward (forward b) = b
